line.text: Three sharp knocks, one softer. A pause exactly the length of a held breath.
So. Day one. I lost a bet. You're the bet. Hi.
I made extra. It would have gone bad. Don't make it weird.
She transfers the container to your hands with more force than the exchange requires.
I'm fulfilling the terms. That's all this is. You're welcome.
Her ears track your face before she decides to look at you.

options.text: Thanks. So what are the terms, exactly?

reaction.text: Terms. Right. You get one nice thing per day. I don't have to explain the nice thing.
And you don't get to ask why I'm being nice. Because I'm not. I'm compliant.

options.text: Extra? What was the original amount?

reaction.text: The original amount was a normal amount. I doubled it. For reasons.
That's not - can you just accept the thing and not analyze it?

options.text: Nice of you to bring food on day one.

reaction.text: I'm not being nice. I'm being efficient. It's different.
Her tail wraps once around her ankle, then releases.

line.text: Anyway. Day one is handled. I'm going back to my apartment. To not think about this.
She doesn't move. Her ears stay angled toward you.
You lasted longer than I thought. I had you at four days. Impressive.
The headband is crooked. She hasn't touched it once since she knocked.

choice.prompt: She's still standing there. What do you do?

options.text: Want to come in and actually eat some of this?

reaction.text: That's not part of the terms. But fine. Ten minutes. I'm timing it.
She steps past you into the kitchen before you answer, tail high.

options.text: Four days? I'm insulted. I could go at least a week.

reaction.text: A week. Bold. I'll adjust the spreadsheet.
But if you last a week, I get to pick the next bet. House rules.

options.text: So the bet is just you being nice for thirty days?

reaction.text: It's not being nice. It's compliance. There's a difference and I will die on it.
Her ears go completely still. She looks at the container instead of you.

desc: Three sharp knocks, one softer. Mako is at your door holding food: she made extra, and she is only here because she lost a bet, as she explains with far too much conviction.
